features: AMOLED Display & Long Battery: Enjoy a bright, colorful AMOLED display with up to 11 days of battery life in smartwatch mode.

Body Battery: Monitor your energy levels with personalized insights from sleep, naps, stress, workouts and daily activity to know when to rest. Comprehensive Health Monitoring: Body Battery, Track heart rate, stress, fitness age, morning report, menstrual cycle, pregnancy, meditation and more.

Advanced Sleep Monitoring: Get a sleep score, personalized coaching, improvement tips and HRV insights to better understand your health. Automatic Nap Tracking: Detects and logs naps automatically, providing personalized insights into how nap duration affects your Body Battery energy levels.

30+ Built in Sports : Stay active with 30+ built-in indoor and GPS sports apps for walking, running, cycling, HIIT, swimming, golf and more. Workouts & Garmin Coach: Access cardio, yoga, strength, HIIT and Pilates workouts, create custom routines or use adaptive Garmin Coach plans.

Advanced Training & Recovery: Understand workout benefits and track recovery time to know how your body responds and when it’s ready to train again.
Phone-Free Music: Download playlists from Spotify, Amazon Music and enjoy your favorite music directly from your watch with wireless headphones.
